title: Prior Authorization Clinical Policy: Adalimumab (Humira) for Moderate to Severe Rheumatoid Arthritis
regulatory_framework: CMS-0057-F / American College of Rheumatology (ACR) Guidelines / ERISA 503
summary: Governs biologic therapy authorization for Rheumatoid Arthritis. Mandates diagnostic confirmation of moderate-to-severe disease, documentation of conventional synthetic DMARD step-therapy trial, and active infection/TB screening.

criteria.name: Diagnosis of Moderate-to-Severe Active Rheumatoid Arthritis
criteria.description: Established diagnosis of active moderate-to-severe RA evidenced by persistent synovitis in >= 3 joints, elevated ESR/CRP, or positive RF/anti-CCP.
criteria.statutory_reference: ACR 2021 Guideline for the Treatment of Rheumatoid Arthritis

criteria.name: Step Therapy: Trial and Inadequate Response/Intolerance to Methotrexate or csDMARD
criteria.description: Documented trial of oral or subcutaneous Methotrexate (>= 15mg/week for at least 12 weeks), or documented contraindication/intolerance, or trial of alternative csDMARD (Leflunomide, Sulfasalazine).
criteria.statutory_reference: ACR Step Therapy Protocol; State Step-Therapy Reform Acts

criteria.name: Documentation: Negative Latent Tuberculosis (TB) Screen within 12 Months
criteria.description: Negative QuantiFERON-TB Gold, T-SPOT, or tuberculin skin test (PPD) within past 12 months, or completion of appropriate prophylactic regimen.
criteria.statutory_reference: CDC / ACR Biologic Safety Screening Guidelines

criteria.name: Exclusion: Active Serious or Opportunistic Infection
criteria.description: Therapy contraindicated in patients with active systemic infection, sepsis, or untreated viral hepatitis B/C.
